description:
Emotional Intelligence, Daily. Start now: https://www.theschooloflife.com/subscription/ Is a "fear of intimacy" really just a character flaw, or is it a rational defense mechanism born from experience? While society often labels those who push love away as "cowardly" or "avoidant," the reality is often much deeper. Love is a high-stakes gamble that requires us to hand over the keys to our self-worth; to those who have been deeply hurt, the terror of intimacy isn't a sign of weakness—it's a sign of having truly understood the price of heartbreak. In this film, we explore why this fear is so profoundly logical and how our earliest experiences shape our capacity to open up.
